prior_test_policy: exclude original OPS-SAT official test=0 entirely; no tuning against previously published test
data_source: existing official OPS-SAT-AD dataset.csv (18 precomputed segment features)
selector: Fisher rank using fit labels, and existing MSF-MOFS implementation on fit only, population=12/generations=5/seed=42
measured_time: performance_counter wall-clock on one fixed GitHub Actions CPU; single BLAS/OpenMP thread
decision: descriptive Pareto analysis only; no re-selection of frozen delivery models
feature_engineering_caveat: official 18 statistical features precomputed for entire segment; raw feature extraction runtime and online causal compute are not measured
scope: Within one real satellite dataset only; no cross-dataset/transfer learning experiments, no physical 3-state validation
